title: What Happens If You Get Stung By A Bullet Ant?
sources: Schmidt Sting Pain Index: bullet ant rated 4+ (highest possible), described as 'waves of burning, throbbing, all-consuming pain' lasting 24 hours
PLOS ONE, 'The sting of the bullet ant Paraponera clavata' — venom contains poneratoxin, a neuroactive peptide causing uncontrolled nerve firing
Wikipedia, Bullet ant: Satere-Mawe tribe initiation ritual — boys wear gloves of woven bullet ants for 10 minutes, 20 times over months
Healthline: venom blocks pain-inhibiting neurotransmitters, causing involuntary muscle contractions and temporary paralysis of the sting site
